name: Entropius
source:
Entropius, which derives from the name Entropy, meaning "a process of degradation or running down or a trend to disorder (Merriam-Webster)," is a Visual Novel RPG with a heavy focus on character and world interactions. As a Detective in a fantasy world, you discover that the magic energy is being depleted. You will find yourself in the midst of a mystery that is causing tension throughout the world. It is only a matter of time before the declining peace erupts into a battle for power. Your decisions will have an impact in how the story concludes, and the responses you give in conversation will determine the future of yourself and those you hold dearest.

Our game focuses on being accessible to all while creating engaging interactions alongside a story filled with mystery, relationships, excitement, and suspense. While the dangers being posed to the world are threatening, Entropius remains intimate to personal connections and the emotional repercussions of difficult, if not dangerous times.

[From [url=https://jennaperkin.itch.io/entropius]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Entropius》一名源自Entropy（熵）；Merriam-Webster將其釋為「衰退或耗盡的過程，或趨於混亂的傾向」。這是一款注重角色與世界互動的視覺小說RPG。你將扮演奇幻世界中的一名偵探，發現魔法能量正在枯竭。你會捲入一場令整個世界局勢緊張的謎團之中。和平不斷衰退，權力之爭爆發只是時間問題。你的決定會影響故事的結局，而你在對話中的回應則將決定自己以及摯愛之人的未來。

本作致力於讓所有人都能輕鬆上手，同時提供引人入勝的互動體驗。故事充滿謎團、人際關係、刺激與懸念。儘管世界正面臨威脅，《Entropius》仍著眼於人與人之間的連結，以及艱難乃至危險時期帶來的情感衝擊。

[來源：[url=https://jennaperkin.itch.io/entropius]Itch.io[/url]]
